text:
amanda: Heads-up  I opened a preview run for the "config-prune" flow. It will surface stale runtime keys in Console as "At-risk" (preview only). Want ops/telemetry/DevEx thumbs before any destructive step.

josh: Thanks. Quick clarifying questions: how do you define stale? and what about keys that are only read by non-runtime tooling?

amanda: Stale = no runtime lookup events in the last 120d by default. We'll count runtime `config.lookup` and console-preview lookups as usage. Non-runtime tooling that never triggers a lookup will not protect a key unless it writes an explicit `retain:true` label.

ops-bot: [job] config-prune.preview started: run=config-prune-2024-09-02T10:00Z id=cp-20240902-1 :gear:

telemetry: For visibility we'll emit `config_prune.preview.start`, `config_prune.preview.item` (sampled), and `config_prune.preview.report`. Include owner, last_seen, lookups_120d, created_at, labels, and owner_resolution. We'll also add metrics: `config_prune.candidate_count` and `config_prune.pending_by_owner`.

prashant: Policy suggestion: exclude keys <90d old from delete eligibility and surface 60-90d as "young-unused" in preview. Respect `no-prune` / `retain:true` labels. Sampling: 1% for low-traffic (<3 lookups/month) candidates, 100% for last_seen >360d and zero lookups.

marie: UX asks: Console should show an "At-risk keys" card on the service homepage and a key detail banner with timeline + CTAs: "Request hold (7d)" and "Mark safelist". Also need a bulk-review modal for owners. If owner unresolved, show banner to `platform-ops`.

defex: (devex) I'll prepare modal copy and an email digest template for owners during preview. Recommend adding a link to the delete-plan diff CSV in the digest.

josh: Scale notes: scanning the whole store is expensive. Use cursored shard iteration, maintain checkpoint watermarks, and cap preview to 4k keys/hour for the first week. Also prefer incremental candidates so subsequent runs only touch new data.

amanda: Agreed. We'll implement shard cursors + watermark and a per-run cap. Also will produce a delete-plan diff CSV in S3 for owner review.

telemetry: Example event (sampled) we'll emit for owner review (will validate schema in repo):

```
{
  "event": "config_prune.preview.item",
  "key": "checkout.experimental_retry.v2",
  "owner": "checkout-service",
  "owner_resolved_from": "metadata.owner",
  "created_at": "2023-01-12T09:00:00Z",
  "last_seen": "2023-04-15T12:34:00Z",
  "lookups_120d": 0,
  "labels": ["experiment"],
  "safelist": false
}
```

prashant: Ops safety: require snapshot before any hard prune, tombstone retention 14d, and a pre-delete smoke-restore job that randomly restores a handful of items to verify snapshots. Also require ops approval for first production prune and an emergency `undelete` endpoint that accepts `rollback_token` tied to the prune event.

amanda: We'll add `rollback_token` per prune batch and log its issuance. Token valid until tombstone expiry. Deletion flow will be: snapshot -> dry-run preview -> owner 7-day reclaim window via Console -> (ops approval) -> prune -> tombstone 14d -> final purge.

josh: Another edge-case: keys used only in canary tenants. We should attribute lookups by tenant and not globally prune if any live tenant shows activity. Also surface tenant-level breakdown in the diff.

marie: UI should show tenant breakdown and the timeline chart of lookups over last 360d in the key detail. That helps product decide quickly.

devex: We'll include prefilled owner emails in the modal and a one-click action to request extension (owner can push to 30d hold). Also propose weekly owner digests while preview is active.

telemetry: Metrics we'll add to the telemetry repo: `config_prune.candidates_total`, `config_prune.sampled_events`, `config_prune.pending_owners_gauge`. We'll also add a small alert if candidate count spikes > 3x baseline for a service.

ops-bot: [ops] initial rate limit: preview capped at 4k keys/hour and will run with shard backoff. Audit event `config_prune.preview.started` created.

prashant: One procedural ask: the delete-plan diff must include owner_resolution_trace (metadata -> audit.creator -> last_writer -> fallback:platform-ops) and a confidence score for owner. That'll reduce owner disputes.

amanda: Will include trace + confidence in CSV. Also adding a UI visual for confidence.

josh: LGTM from infra pending PR details on watermark persistence and cursor checkpoints.

marie: LGTM from product for the proposed owner flows and UI elements.

telemetry: Ack, we'll add event schemas and sampling rules to the telemetry repo and wire ingests.

prashant: Ops ack, but require the undelete runbook and operator contact list in the PR before we ever flip dry-run false.

amanda: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/config-prune/pull/58. Holding any destructive action until ops + telemetry + devex thumbs and after a successful canary preview run. Will run preview for 72h and then collect owner feedback. Thanks all. :v:
